title: Arity synchronization invariant between CompositeParamType and Parameter
answers: How does Click enforce nargs for composite types like Tuple?
What causes 'nargs must be X (or None) for type Y'?
How to declare multiple-value types with fixed arity in Click?
body:
Any composite parameter type (`src/click/types.py:CompositeParamType`, `src/click/types.py:Tuple`) must set `is_composite = True` and specify an integer `arity` attribute.
In `src/click/core.py:Parameter.__init__`, Click checks `if self.type.is_composite:` and either sets `nargs = self.type.arity` if `nargs` was `None`, or validates that `nargs == self.type.arity`.
If `nargs` is explicitly specified with a count different from `type.arity`, `Parameter.__init__` raises `TypeError: 'nargs' must be X (or None) for type Y, but it was Z`.
